item.title: Ivy Wealth Management: Minority Investment Raised From Summit Financial

item.title: Paribu Acquiring CoinMENA In A Deal Valued Up To $240 Million
item.description: Paribu, Türkiye’s leading digital asset platform, has completed the country’s largest fintech acquisition by acquiring CoinMENA, the largest local crypto exchange serving the Middle East and North Africa. The transaction values CoinMENA at up to $240 million and marks Türkiye’s first cross-border acquisition involving a digital asset platform. item.title: Syracuse University Whitman School Of Management Launches Orange Business Angel Network
